articles.summary: OKYO today announced participation at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference being held September 9-11, 2026. Presenters: Flavio Mantelli, MD, PhD, Chief Medical Officer, Gary Jacob, PhD, Chief Development Officer. Date/Time: Thursday, September 10 at 8:35 AM ET
articles.title: OKYO Pharma to Participate in a Fireside Chat at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference
